notes: x86-64 -fno-plt: fwd5 is `return five(a,b,c,d,e+1)` through five's GOT slot. Its call once passed four of five's arguments (fwd5 writes r8 after forwarding rdi..rcx), so the check refused the tail call and copied five's body in. With forwarded registers filling their slots it passes all five: the tail call is kept and no copied-in body appears.
